title: Evidence-aligned academic narrative contract
provenance: Applied Sciences MA-SQLGrid narrative revisions v1-v3
Applied Sciences C2GES narrative revisions v1-v2
Mintou six-paper academic narrative audit and submission-quality revision, 2026-08-12 to 2026-08-13

non_negotiable_rules.rule: Never invent authors, affiliations, funding, citations, datasets, expert labels, experiment runs, numerical results, statistical decisions, or deployment evidence. Missing human-confirmed metadata remains an explicit blocker.
Every load-bearing title term must have an operational definition in the method and direct evidence in the evaluation. A brand term alone is not a mechanism.
Map every primary contribution to a result or analysis that directly tests it. Implementation activity, reproducibility, and performance gain are separate claims.
A control that changes two or more mechanisms supports only a joint-bundle conclusion unless separate controls identify the individual effects.

A load-bearing negative or null result must retain the same direction and scope in the abstract, results, discussion, and conclusion. It may motivate redesign but may not be hidden or converted into superiority.

Historical pools, development-visible analyses, proxy corpora, constructed states, and descriptive backtests cannot be written as prospective, causal, expert-validated, operational, or deployment evidence.

Comparison claims must disclose material budget, length, model, prompt, tuning, candidate-pool, data-visibility, and compute asymmetries. Equal sentence count is not equal output length; seed variation is not temporal or population uncertainty.

The main text prioritizes problem, gap, method, evidence, mechanism, application value, and limitations. Hashes, incident chronology, version lineage, file inventories, and exhaustive conformance matrices belong in supplementary or internal records unless scientifically load-bearing.
Results are ordered by research questions and evidential importance, not by execution chronology. The primary empirical finding appears before software-conformance or artifact-integrity details.
Trace production, auditability, source linkage, or interface coverage does not establish explanation quality, semantic correctness, human-review benefit, safety, or deployment readiness.

Companion papers sharing candidates, corpora, generators, figures, or experimental infrastructure must disclose the overlap symmetrically and identify independent questions, methods, run records, result tables, and conclusions.
Page, figure, table, bibliography, and Visual-QA claims are derived from the current compiled artifact. Stale hard-coded counts or checks against an older release are invalid.

An independent rerun reports separately: frozen script/config/input identity, scientific-field identity, derived-table identity, and non-scientific timing differences. Never call a run byte-identical when wall-clock or environment fields differ.
A timed-out worktree is not a candidate. Preserve and hash a WIP patch, attribute the failure, then retry the same approved objective from a clean baseline or create and approve a narrower plan.
Shared evidence needed for tests is a read-only dependency and must not widen the stage write scope, merge gate, or cross-paper contribution boundary.

ieee_access: Treat the submission as near-final because the journal uses a binary decision model.
Technical correctness, independent incremental value, comparison fairness, and reproducibility are decisive; SOTA is not required.
mdpi_electronics: Explain why each information-processing or algorithmic component is necessary.
For prediction papers, use multiple meaningful baselines and at least two appropriate error metrics; negative results are publishable when informative.
mdpi_energies: Connect the method to an energy-system decision or engineering use, and include sensitivity evidence appropriate to the application.
Proxy optimization stability and physical or investment validity are distinct evidence layers.
mdpi_applied_sciences: Prioritize reproducible applied value and name the intended beneficiary without claiming unmeasured operational benefit.
Sensitivity or boundary analysis is a central currency of application credibility; SOTA is not required.

review_sequence: Reconstruct the one-sentence scientific story and identify the primary empirical result.
Check the analysis unit, estimand, uncertainty interpretation, comparison budget, and data visibility.
Check negative and null findings for cross-section continuity.
Separate scientific narrative from reproducibility and audit support.
Check companion overlap, visual-artifact consistency, declarations, and author-confirmed metadata.
Recommend only evidence-preserving edits or explicitly scoped new experiments.
